unit_label: Field 1 Regiment Seventh Brigade Virginia Militia
notes: Petition signatures: E. Sipe lieutenant-colonel. Letter p808 says older brigade condensed into four field regiments after July19; p810 says original two called June21 and ordered to Winchester July2. No exact permanent-number crosswalk or individual July arrival date. Never relabel these as First-Fourth Virginia volunteer infantry.
